checks.command: Re-audit from claimed baseline dc9b6d16: CodeWorkspaceTab.renameSymbol -> real provider prepareRename/rename -> normalizeWorkspaceEditPaths -> prepared v2 refactor journal -> workspace edit writer -> independent disk postcondition -> RefactorRecoveryController -> WorkspaceRecoveryDialog and shared undo
checks.summary: The production rename owner freezes workspace/document/provider facts, normalizes absolute, file-URI, workspace-relative and Windows/UNC paths before preview or mutation, rejects virtual and root-escaping targets, captures complete text preimages, persists a v2 journal before the first mutation, and keeps journal/storage failures visible. Postimages are independently read from disk; mismatch, read/write settlement failure, stale owner, dirty/revision conflict and provider failure do not become committed/history. Recovery is workspace-scoped, exposes pending entries through the real UI, checks every file against known pre/post images before writing, rechecks before each write, verifies every restored preimage, persists partial progress, is idempotent, and leaves v1 journals inspection-only. Resource create/rename/delete recovery remains explicitly out of scope.
The full mounted file rerun was stopped after more than three minutes with no assertion result while its Node worker reached about 1.6 GiB; no PASS is claimed from this run.

6 test files passed; 76/76 tests passed. Assertions cover prepared-journal ordering and storage failure, postcondition mismatch, stale/dirty/third-party conflicts, partial progress, independent preimage verification, v1 inspection-only behavior, idempotent replay, path/URI normalization and workspace containment.
